title: Catering Information
text:
☕ Refreshments, Tea & Coffee will be available on arrival and throughout the day.
🥪 Lunch will be available between 12:30 - 13:30.
You will also have an opportunity to network.
We will cater for those with specific food allergies and/or requirements.
🍕 Refreshments will be available after the Hackathon.

title: Reboot Inclusive Briefing Pack
text:
We have prepared a Reboot Inclusive Briefing Pack which describes what you will experience at the event and includes accessibility information.
A copy is stored on the Reboot event SharePoint site and some printed copies are available at reception.
